I told Dana in a thread on their #north-team message that the seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **261 seats**, as Ilse posted there on 14 Oct. Dana is a member of #north-team, so they could already see that message.

I couldn't confirm 261 is the signed figure. It's the only 2026 number in the channel. The one before it was 185, under Amendment No. 1 in August 2025. Dana and I can't see any Quarrendon renewal document in the shared files. So I suggested Dana check with Ilse or June if the tracker needs the signed number.

A seat count is an operational fact rather than a money term, and Dana is on the account's team, so no approval was needed.
